about: LanguageTool hits accepted after reading, each with its reason. id: one string ('ui:key', 'pack:id'), every string ('*') or a group ('ui:*', 'pack:written.*'); at: only that flagged text. scripts/lang/grammar.mjs fails on a hit no entry covers and on an entry that covers nothing.

另一台 modifies 设备 only, and the list reads plainly as three alternatives; the rule warns of an ambiguity that is not there.
下一首 means 'the next (verse)'; 下 is not the locative word the rule assumes, so 对手的下一首诗 is right.
把 here is the measure word of a key (一把通行密钥, 这把通行密钥), not the 把-construction the rule assumes.
一颗钉子: 颗 is a measure word in common use for nails; the rule's list lacks it.
一声响: 声 is the measure word (一声), so none is missing.
一韵到底 (one rhyme to the end) is the set phrase of Chinese prosody for monorhyme; 韵 needs no measure word in it.
新的通行密钥 (a new passkey): 新的 is an adjective before a noun; the rule took 通行 for a verb and asked for 地.
